primary_endpoint: Change in hepatic venous pressure gradient (HVPG) at week 24.
efficacy_outcome: No significant difference in change in HVPG versus placebo for any dose; adjusted differences were −0.21, −0.45, and −0.58 mmHg for 5, 25, and 50 mg, respectively.
safety_signal: New or worsening decompensating events occurred in approximately 10% over median exposure of 337 days; events and treatment-emergent adverse events were similar across groups. Emricasan appeared safe and well tolerated.
